in_arabic.name: هلاوات
in_arabic.meaning: حسن و خوبي، نيکي، خوشی و خیر
in_arabic.long_meaning: هلاوات هي اسم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل هلا، و يعني حسن و خوبي، نيکي، خوشی و خیر. و در بعضی موارد به معنی سلام و خوش آمدگویی نیز آمده است. این نام در فرهنگ اسلامی به عنوان یک نام نیک و پسندیده شناخته شده است.

in_urdu.name: ہلاوت
in_urdu.meaning: حسن و خوبی، نیکی، خوشی اور خیر
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہلاوت ایک مؤنث نام ہے جو ہلا فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب حسن و خوبی، نیکی، خوشی اور خیر ہے۔ بعض موارد میں اس کا مطلب سلام اور خوش آمدگویی بھی ہے۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں یہ نام ایک اچھا اور پسندیدہ نام ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हलावत
in_hindi.meaning: हसन और خوبी, नेकी, खुशी और खैर
in_hindi.long_meaning: हलावत एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो हला क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है हसन और خوبी, नेकी, खुशी और खैर। कुछ मामलों में इसका अर्थ अभिवादन और स्वागत भी है। इस्लामी संस्कृति में यह नाम एक अच्छा और प्रशंसनीय नाम माना जाता है।

in_english.name: Halaawat
in_english.long_meaning: Halaawat is a feminine name derived from the Arabic verb 'hala', meaning beauty, goodness, happiness, and prosperity. In Islamic tradition, this name is considered a good and commendable name. It is also associated with greetings and warm welcomes. Etymologically, it relates to the Arabic root 'h-l-w', which connotes sweetness and pleasantness. Historically, names like Halaawat have been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing positive attributes and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Halaawat" is not commonly used in Islamic circles as it is not one of the 99 Names of Allah mentioned in the Quran or Hadith. However, in certain Sufi and mystical circles, the name holds cultural significance as a symbol of inner beauty, radiance, and illumination. It is believed that recognizing and cultivating one's inner light is essential to spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_significance: In Sufism, the name "Halaawat" represents a deep spiritual longing and yearning for the divine presence and guidance. It is a reminder of the presence of Allah within the heart of every believer, guiding them on their spiritual journey towards union with the divine. The name is a call to remember the light of Allah that illuminates the inner self, and to strive towards as-salaam alaikum - peace and blessings from Allah. May Allah guide us all on our paths towards his presence and illumination.
